description: For every full Peano model \(M\), there is an arithmetic isomorphism \(e:\mathbb N_A\to M\) with \(e(n)=n_M\) for every natural number \(n\).

      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderArithmetic.peanoTheory) :
